essence: The rite is to be performed according to the stated khalūrikā method.
The brick-on-head rite is performed by the rite stated for the abode.
One makes an upward mountain and places four of them each.
The presiding deities of this are accompanied by knowledge-named action.
Without emanation and without brahma, the cause is named as such.
